**Ms William Evans is placed on a Patient-Initiated Follow-Up (PIFU) pathway for 12 months.** No antiarrhythmic medication required. No routine hospital appointment scheduled. Driving advice given in line with DVLA guidance for WPW post-successful ablation.
Yours sincerely,

Dr Fiona Lester, Consultant in Cardiac Electrophysiology

Dr Priya Nair, Consultant Heart Failure Specialist
